purpose: Maps the v42 property-charging demand/friction signal into the same canonical Stödassistenten regression system.

mappings.product_miss: The coverage matrix already named mobility/vehicle/charging as a high-priority verified domain, but the BRF/property actor had only a housing-adaptation route. A generic answer could collapse a BRF's Ladda bilen application, company employee/tenant charging, the distinct company guest exception and an individual resident's 2026 charging-point request into one path, creating wrong timing, amount or approval implications. Red Team specifically falsified the first implementation because it incorrectly applied the company employee/tenant pre-start rule to guest charging even though Naturvårdsverket allows the guest path both before and after installation starts.
product_surfaces: shared source registry and support-record schema
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Use one property_charging capability in the existing shell/person product. Preserve only explicit coarse route facts, separate association and company use categories before applying state-aid/timing rules, ask work-start state only where it can change the route, preserve the company guest-start exception, and send individual resident requests to the separate current housing-law source rather than the organisation grant path. No property charging app or duplicate matcher.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Do not place address, organisation number, parking-space identifier, exact project cost, quote text, vehicle details, aid-history documents, tenancy documents or raw story in URL, public eval feedback or learning events. Handoff is limited to coarse actor/focus/language plus optional coarse charging context, use category and resident parking scope when those facts were already explicit.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Naturvårdsverket and current Riksdagen sources govern material claims. Normalized charging records remain NEEDS_REVIEW with human review required and zero AI-promoted material fields. Do not infer grant approval, aid intensity, de-minimis headroom, state-aid classification, work-start eligibility or resident statutory eligibility from natural-language input.
